title: Pointwise global canonical resolution section transfer
statement: For schemes X and Y, a morphism g : Y ⟶ X, a sheaf G on X, injective resolutions I and J, an augmentation-preserving chain map α, canonical comparisons cX and cY, a degree q and a class x in the degree-q homology of the global sections complex of I, cY.globalEquiv q applied to the homology map induced by globalResolutionSectionTransfer equals cohomologyMap g G q applied to cX.globalEquiv q x.

proof.text: Represent x by a cycle using surjectivity of homologyπ. The constant-sheaf sections adjunction identifies its image under iCycles with a cocycle f. Adjoint α componentwise to obtain β and transport hα to augmentation compatibility. Naturality of the sections adjunction and the terminal pullback identifies the transferred cycle with the cocycle obtained by precomposing F(f);β with the constant-sheaf comparison. The adjunction comparison is calculated locally from Mathlib leftAdjointUniq identities; no duplicate helper declaration is introduced.

Apply exactFunctor_resolution_cocycle to the exact inverse-image functor and the identity coefficient morphism, and simplify Ext.comp_mk₀_id. Normalize the two representing cycles using cX.global_cocycle and cY.global_cocycle; cohomologyMap_apply and InjectiveResolution.mk₀_comp_extMk identify the resulting equality with the requested transfer identity.
